The '''Old Galactic Market Concourse Bazaar''' was located in [[Old Galactic Market Concourse|Concourse]] section of the [[Old Galactic Market]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It contained most of the safe shopping areas available in the Old Galactic Market after the [[Coruscant riots (3653 BBY)|Coruscant riots]] in [[3653 BBY]] and the take over of most of the Galactic Market by the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]].
